oracle.scope: 6.l.W persists the existing inert WorkManifest and its exact object set through segmented hash-addressed inventories and a checked predecessor chain anchored in the caller-trusted initial manifest. Existing native exclusive creation and atomic image replacement primitives fsync all required files/directories before switching work.json. Data-only inspection uses the native work mutex without creating/removing owner records, so a crashed publisher leaves either the prior complete generation or the fully secured new one readable; orphan records still block writes. Previous checkpoints, all objects and partial own files remain retained. Real process restart/exit tests prove current stored-byte selection, not command execution or runtime resume. No Code 8, execution authority, all-command coverage, cache-cleanup integration, automatic recovery, bounded whole-store memory or non-native filesystem durability is asserted.
